primaryIdPolicy: Stable requirement IDs are primary. Numeric and source ReqID values are aliases only.

sourceAnomalies.note: One observed row has a blank ReqID. Its row association is not asserted here, and a blank value is never a runtime identifier.

requirements.title: Standards/guidelines declared
requirements.description: The report declares the accessibility standards or guidelines it addresses.
requirements.guidance: Name the standards and versions whose conformance tables are included.

requirements.title: Only tested standards listed
requirements.description: The report does not present an untested standard as evaluated coverage.
requirements.guidance: List a standard as covered only when the report contains the corresponding completed evaluation.

requirements.title: At least one standard covered
requirements.description: The report provides coverage for at least one declared accessibility standard.
requirements.guidance: Include a completed conformance table for at least one declared standard.

requirements.title: Conformance Level terms defined
requirements.description: The report defines the conformance terms used in its criterion results.
requirements.guidance: Provide definitions for each conformance term used in the report.

requirements.title: All criteria answered for level
requirements.description: Every criterion in each declared conformance level has an answer.
requirements.guidance: Complete every applicable row for the declared WCAG version and levels, and explain any exclusions.

requirements.title: Evaluation methods described
requirements.description: The report describes how accessibility was evaluated.
requirements.guidance: Summarize the evaluation methods used to produce the report.

requirements.title: AT testing described
requirements.description: The report describes any assistive-technology testing represented in its findings.
requirements.guidance: Identify the assistive technologies and relevant test context, or clearly state the testing boundary.

requirements.title: Manual testing described
requirements.description: The report describes the manual evaluation represented in its findings.
requirements.guidance: Identify the manual methods and relevant test context, or clearly state the testing boundary.

requirements.title: Automated tools described
requirements.description: The report describes the automated tools represented in its findings.
requirements.guidance: Identify automated tools and relevant versions or clearly state that none were used.

requirements.title: Contact info provided
requirements.description: The report provides a way to contact the reporting organization about accessibility information.
requirements.guidance: Provide a maintained accessibility contact method.

requirements.title: Tester product familiarity statement
requirements.description: The report states the testers' familiarity with the evaluated product.
requirements.guidance: Describe the testers' product familiarity or relevant evaluation context.

requirements.title: Product description provided
requirements.description: The report identifies and describes the product being evaluated.
requirements.guidance: Provide enough product and version context to identify the subject of the report.

requirements.title: Notes state scope/coverage
requirements.description: Report notes explain the evaluation scope and coverage boundary.
requirements.guidance: State included product areas, versions, platforms, and material exclusions.

requirements.title: Remarks filled for all criteria
requirements.description: Every criterion row includes remarks or explanatory evidence.
requirements.guidance: Add criterion-specific remarks that support each conformance statement.

requirements.title: Template version listed
requirements.description: The report identifies the VPAT template version used.
requirements.guidance: State the template version explicitly; V1 accepts VPAT 2.5 only.

requirements.title: Report date present
requirements.description: The report includes its publication or completion date.
requirements.guidance: Provide a clear report date so readers can judge the currency of the findings.
